title: Jazzy Chiapan Wheat Huaraches
description: A cultured, creamy, midnight-craving Mexican dish featuring whole wheat and a savory nimono-simmer.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix whole wheat flour, nutritional yeast, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
In another bowl, whisk oat milk, vegetable broth, tomato paste, minced garlic, and diced onion until smooth.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until no lumps remain.
Transfer mixture to a medium pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the tomato paste and continue simmering, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes to thicken.
Stir in fresh cilantro and lime juice, allowing the flavor to meld for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the creamy huaraches as a warm casserole or pour into baking dish and finish under the broiler until golden, about 3 minutes.
